title.en: Acts
title.zh: 使徒行传

subtitle.en: Bible study summaries, most recent first
subtitle.zh: 圣经学习摘要，按最近的聚会顺序排列

title.en: Acts 10:39–48 — Peter's Sermon to Cornelius
title.zh: 使徒行传 10:39-48 — 彼得向哥尼流的讲道

excerpt.en: The five core elements of Peter's gospel, the Spirit poured out on the Gentiles, and the order of salvation.
excerpt.zh: 彼得福音信息的五个核心要素、圣灵浇灌在外邦人身上，以及救恩的顺序。

title.en: Acts 10:24-38 — Peter at Cornelius's House: God Shows No Favoritism
title.zh: 使徒行传 10:24-38 — 彼得在哥尼流家：神不偏待人

excerpt.en: God's simultaneous preparation of Peter and Cornelius, peace in two dimensions, and who the man in shining clothes was.
excerpt.zh: 神同时预备彼得与哥尼流，平安的两个层面，以及那位身穿光明衣服的人是谁。

title.en: Acts 10:1-23 — Cornelius and Peter: Two Parallel Transformations
title.zh: 使徒行传 10:1-23 — 哥尼流与彼得：两个平行的转变

excerpt.en: God's turning point in Acts, opening the gospel to the Gentiles through two men prepared at once.
excerpt.zh: 使徒行传的转折点，神藉两个人同时的预备，向外邦人开启福音。

title.en: Acts 9:20-43 — Saul's Escape, Aeneas & Dorcas Raised
title.zh: 使徒行传 9:20-43 — 扫罗的逃脱、以尼亚与多加复活

excerpt.en: Saul's immediate preaching, his humbling escape from Damascus, and two miracles that pointed past themselves.
excerpt.zh: 扫罗立即的传道、他在大马士革谦卑的逃脱，以及两个指向神而非自身的神迹。

title.en: Acts 9:1-19 — Saul's Conversion & God's Sovereign Grace
title.zh: 使徒行传 9:1-19 — 扫罗的归信与神的主权恩典

excerpt.en: Grace that comes looking for us, transformation through humility, and an ordinary believer named Ananias.
excerpt.zh: 主动寻找我们的恩典、藉谦卑而来的转变，以及一位平凡的信徒亚拿尼亚。

title.en: Acts 8:30-40 — Baptism, Prophecy Fulfilled & the Eunuch's Joy
title.zh: 使徒行传 8:30-40 — 洗礼、预言的应验与太监的喜乐

excerpt.en: What baptism actually means, Isaiah 53 fulfilled, and understanding Jesus' anguish in Gethsemane.
excerpt.zh: 洗礼真正的意义、以赛亚书53章的应验，以及理解耶稣在客西马尼园的痛苦。

title.en: Acts 8:18-35 — Simon's Error & Philip and the Ethiopian Eunuch
title.zh: 使徒行传 8:18-35 — 西门的错误与腓利传福音给埃塞俄比亚太监

excerpt.en: Simon's misunderstanding of the Spirit, and a high official who humbly asked for help understanding Scripture.
excerpt.zh: 西门对圣灵的误解，以及一位谦卑求助以明白经文的高级官员。

title.en: Acts 8:1-17 — Scattered to Samaria: Philip, Simon & the Spirit
title.zh: 使徒行传 8:1-17 — 分散到撒玛利亚：腓利、西门与圣灵

excerpt.en: Persecution scatters the church into Samaria, and the difference between the Spirit's inward and outward work.
excerpt.zh: 逼迫使教会分散到撒玛利亚，以及圣灵内在与外在工作的区别。

title.en: Acts 7 — Stephen's Speech & Martyrdom
title.zh: 使徒行传第七章 — 司提反的讲道与殉道

excerpt.en: Abraham, Joseph, and Moses as proof God is not confined to the temple, and the church's first martyr.
excerpt.zh: 亚伯拉罕、约瑟与摩西证明神不受圣殿局限，以及教会第一位殉道者。

title.en: Acts 5:33-6:15 — Gamaliel's Counsel, Seven Deacons & Stephen
title.zh: 使徒行传 5:33-6:15 — 迦玛列的劝告、七位执事与司提反

excerpt.en: A respected teacher's caution, the church's first internal conflict, and Stephen's introduction.
excerpt.zh: 一位受尊敬教师的劝告、教会第一次的内部冲突，以及司提反的登场。

title.en: Acts 5:12-32 — Signs and Wonders, and Obeying God Rather Than People
title.zh: 使徒行传 5:12-32 — 神迹奇事与顺从神而非顺从人

excerpt.en: An angel's jailbreak, two kinds of fear, and a modern story of obedience at real cost.
excerpt.zh: 天使的越狱、两种惧怕，以及一个真实付代价顺服的现代故事。

title.en: Acts 4:32-5:11 — Barnabas's Generosity & Ananias and Sapphira's Deception
title.zh: 使徒行传 4:32-5:11 — 巴拿巴的慷慨与亚拿尼亚、撒非喇的欺骗

excerpt.en: The real sin wasn't withholding money but lying to the Holy Spirit, and the church's name first appears.
excerpt.zh: 真正的罪不是保留钱财，而是向圣灵说谎，"教会"一词也首次出现。

title.en: Acts 4:27-35 — Shaken by Prayer & a Shared Life
title.zh: 使徒行传 4:27-35 — 祷告中的震动与凡物公用的生活

excerpt.en: A repeating pattern of persecution and prayer, and why the resurrection stays the center of the gospel.
excerpt.zh: 逼迫与祷告反复出现的模式，以及复活为何始终是福音的核心。

title.en: Acts 4 — Bold Under Persecution: the Early Church's Prayer
title.zh: 使徒行传第四章 — 逼迫中的勇气：早期教会的祷告

excerpt.en: Two kinds of sin, and a prayer that asked for boldness rather than for persecution to stop.
excerpt.zh: 两种罪的区别，以及一个求胆量而非求逼迫停止的祷告。

title.en: Acts 4:1-14 — Before the Sanhedrin: Jesus the Cornerstone
title.zh: 使徒行传 4:1-14 — 在公会面前：房角石耶稣

excerpt.en: The only cornerstone, the only name, and how persecution actually fuels the church's growth.
excerpt.zh: 唯一的房角石、唯一的名，以及逼迫如何反倒推动教会的增长。

title.en: Acts 3:17-26 — The Prophesied Messiah & the Call to Repent
title.zh: 使徒行传 3:17-26 — 预言中的弥赛亚与悔改的呼召

excerpt.en: Love and justice together, real repentance, and Moses and Joseph as types of Christ.
excerpt.zh: 爱与公义同行、真正的悔改，以及摩西与约瑟对基督的预表。

title.en: Acts 3 — Healing at the Beautiful Gate & Peter's Sermon
title.zh: 使徒行传第3章 — 美门口的医治与彼得的讲道

excerpt.en: A beggar at a beautiful gate, eye contact before the healing, and what actually changes a heart.
excerpt.zh: 美门前的乞丐、医治前的眼神交流，以及真正能改变人心的是什么。

title.en: Acts 2 — Peter's Pentecost Sermon & the Early Church's Shared Life
title.zh: 使徒行传第二章 — 彼得的五旬节讲道与早期教会的团契生活

excerpt.en: Peter's use of the Psalms, Sinai and Pentecost compared, and how the new church actually lived together.
excerpt.zh: 彼得对诗篇的引用、西奈山与五旬节的对照，以及新生教会实际的团契生活。

title.en: Revival Movements in Church History
title.zh: 教会历史中的复兴运动

excerpt.en: From Azusa Street to underground churches in China, and what unites every true revival.
excerpt.zh: 从阿苏萨街到中国的家庭教会，以及一切真实复兴共同的根基。

title.en: Jewish Festivals, Pentecost & the Gift of Tongues
title.zh: 犹太节期、五旬节与方言的恩赐

excerpt.en: How the spring feasts foreshadowed Christ, and the real difference between private and public tongues.
excerpt.zh: 春季节期如何预表基督，以及私人方言与公共方言真正的区别。

title.en: Acts 1 — The Ascension, the Promise of the Spirit & the New Apostle
title.zh: 使徒行传第一章 — 升天、圣灵的应许与新使徒

excerpt.en: Why the Mount of Olives, how a new apostle was chosen, and God's sovereignty alongside human free will.
excerpt.zh: 为何是橄榄山、新使徒如何选立，以及神的主权与人的自由意志。

title.en: The Kingdom of God, the Ascension & the Return of Christ
title.zh: 神的国、升天与基督的再来

excerpt.en: Israel's restoration, spiritual and physical, and why God chose ordinary Galileans as his witnesses.
excerpt.zh: 以色列复兴的属灵与物质层面，以及神为何拣选平凡的加利利人作见证人。

title.en: Introduction to Acts — Structure, Authorship & the Kingdom of God
title.zh: 使徒行传导论 — 结构、作者与神的国

excerpt.en: Why Luke wrote two volumes, the shape of Acts, and what it means to live as Kingdom citizens now.
excerpt.zh: 路加为何写下上下两卷书、使徒行传的结构，以及现在就作神国子民的意义。
